company.name: XPay
company.shortDescription: One platform to accept, manage, and grow every payment.
company.description:
XPay is a payment infrastructure company that gives Egyptian businesses control over their payment operations. As payments become a core part of how a business runs, XPay provides the systems to process them, see how they perform, and act on what the data shows — built on a foundation of transparency, clarity, and consistency. We compete on the quality of that infrastructure and the intelligence built into it, not on breadth of footprint or sales promises. The product is the proof.
Underpinning that is global-standard technology, built for Egypt. The architecture, developer tooling, and data layer match how the best modern platforms in the world are built. The market focus, payment methods, compliance, and support are tuned specifically to Egyptian businesses. We are deliberately single-market: XPay is built for Egypt, and that focus is a feature, not a limitation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $750,000, or 95.54% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $185,000 to $2,000,000, a 10.81x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 55 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
